section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section discusses the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) and its newer version (BAS-2) as measures of positive body image. The text reviews previous cross-cultural validation studies of the BAS-2 conducted in China and Iran with university students, and then introduces the present study, which aims to investigate the psychometric properties of the BAS-2 in a Dutch-speaking sample of women in the Netherlands. The present study (Study X) represents one primary investigation within this paper.
